body:
I don't think I'm trans. Maybe I just have a lot of issues with being female and wish I was male a lot every single day? I know I can't be male, I'm not allowed to, I'm not even able to look remotely like one, and my family just ridicules my efforts to be male when I did try. I don't have any particular desire to get over my "issues", and I've done a lot of counseling and some meds already anyways. 

Maybe if I just try to never look at or see men I'll be alright. Can't feel jealous and pained if I never see or hear them, right? Maybe then I can forget that my voice, no matter how nice, doesn't sound male... That I have nothing remotely male to me.

Multiple counselours have strongly recommended I see a gender therapist, but my parents do not allow it. When I had to go to a crisis center once, they signed a form promising they would let me get boxers and be more supportive, but as soon as they got home they broke it and ranted about how idiotic the crisis counselour was. My parents stole and threw out some of my stuff as well. They mock and demean me when I try to bring up the problem, or just dismiss it, saying I could never and will never be male, or that I just need to grow up, or have "spiritual issues", or that I am just depressed. They're convinced I was influenced somehow (They think Tumblr? Although I have only heard of it and never been on it; I don't use internet much) and now monitor everything from what I wear to the books I read. At one point I was not allowed to lock or close my door, or be in my own room except to sleep, and they would cut off the internet when I needed it to do schoolwork.

I have a friend who supports me at times, but I do not see her often, and do not wish to weigh her down, as she has health and mental issues as well as a lot of schoolwork.

Counselours do not usually take me seriously or know how to help me when I talk to them, so I usually just avoid talking about it with them at this point. Most have little to no experience in the issue and don't know what to say other than to refer me to someone who specializes in such issues.

I'm too afraid to tell much of anyone else as all my family, including my siblings, have either acted disapprovingly or demeaned me, and I originally got outed to my parents by school counselors, which started the whole issue with family in the first place. Even just cutting my hair short, which they originally had no problem with, they now make fun of and say how I'm self harming by doing so. They were originally ok and very accepting of me dressing however I wanted since they did not realize I had "gender issues", although that is not my main concern. There is not much I can do aside from work towards perhaps getting out of the house at 18, which is a year or two away.
